scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/ibpm run build
scripts.typecheck:libs: pnpm --filter @workspace/db --filter @workspace/api-client-react --filter @workspace/api-zod exec tsc --noEmit --composite false --emitDeclarationOnly false --declarationMap false
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/ibpm --filter @workspace/scripts --filter @workspace/solana-client run typecheck
